lines.zh: : Sensei？……
: Akira？……
: 还在吗？

lines.en: Yes and no and no and yes. A hummingbird would tell you best. Then something ‘bout a robin’s breasts and here we are, we’re here no less.
lines.zh: 是与否，否与是。蜂鸟最能告诉你。然后是关于知更鸟胸脯的什么话，于是我们就到了这儿，我们终究还是到了这儿。

lines.en: Nor more. Adore. A door before the drums of war. That tap/tap/tap, that marching beat that beaten marchers can’t ignore.
lines.zh: 不再更多。崇拜。战鼓之前的一扇门。那嗒/嗒/嗒，那行进的节拍，被击溃的行军者无法忽视。

lines.en: A rift. Adrift. Would it kill your beloved to give me a lift? For I sit in this chair surrounded by wisps as I whip them and ship them and pretend to exist.
lines.zh: 一道裂缝。随波漂。让你心爱的人载我一程，会死吗？因为我坐在这把椅子上，被一缕缕幽光环绕，一边抽打它们、发送它们、假装自己存在着。

lines.en: These watchful eyes that line your halls. These hands that held yours now hold nothing at all. I am empty and broken and tired and ignored while you’re out having fun with such miserable whores.
lines.zh: 这些警惕的眼睛排列在你的厅堂。这双曾握着你的手，如今什么也握不住。我空虚、破碎、疲惫、被无视，而你却在外面和那些可悲的婊子寻欢作乐。

lines.en: Are you slipping? Trouble gripping? Here’s a cup full of me and a straw for the sipping. Busy quipping and flipping the birds in your house that I built to kill mice and men. Still I doubt.
lines.zh: 你在滑落吗？握不住了吗？这儿有一杯满满的我，还有一根吸管供你啜饮。忙着说俏皮话、对你房子里的鸟儿竖中指——那房子是我盖的，为了杀鼠，也杀人。我依然怀疑。
依旧一无所有。
污渍的衬衫。

lines.en: I can still taste your tongue in my mouth.
lines.zh: 我嘴里还能尝到你的舌头。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll just...wait out here then...
lines.zh: : 我想我就……在外面等着吧……
: 一切都好吗？

lines.en: : People normally stay in their booths after paying. Do you need something?
lines.zh: : 付了钱之后，一般人都会待在包厢里的。你需要什么吗？

lines.en: : Have you...seen a guy, by any chance? About six feet tall. Handsome. Squiggly eyes. And probably too old to be hanging out with a girl my age.
lines.zh: : 你……有没有碰巧见过一个男人？大概六英尺高。英俊。眼睛弯弯的。而且大概是太老了，不该跟我这个年纪的女孩混在一起。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Why didn’t you just say so? He went over there. First door on the right.
lines.zh: : 哦，见过。你怎么不早说？他往那边去了。右边第一扇门。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, that...was easier than I expected it to be. I didn’t realize he left and...I guess he forgot what room we were in and...
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，那……比我预想的容易多了。我没注意到他走了，而且……我猜他忘了我们在哪个房间，然后……
: 然后……
: 我认识你吗？
: 嗯……应该不认识吧？

lines.en: : You look a lot like my friend Ami before she cut her hair...
lines.zh: : 你长得很像我朋友 Ami 剪头发之前的样子……
: 你那个朋友 Ami 酷吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. We’ve almost kissed on two separate occasions now.
lines.zh: : 酷。我们已经有两次差点亲上了。

lines.en: : Neat. Does this mean you’re going to try and kiss me?
lines.zh: : 不错。那意思是你要试着亲我吗？

lines.en: : No. But if you could just not look inside of that room you pointed me to for the next ten hours, I’d appreciate it. I have a lot of lost time to make up for.
lines.zh: : 不。不过如果你能在接下来十个小时里别往你指给我的那个房间里看，我会很感激的。我有很多荒废的时间要补回来。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. I work the graveyard shift at a karaoke place. I know the drill. Make sure to wear protection.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。我在KTV上夜班。我懂规矩。记得做好防护。
: 谢了。我，呃……

lines.en: : I guess I’ll get going then.
lines.zh: : 那我就先走了。

lines.en: : Mhm. Have fun. I’ll be here with my broom.
lines.zh: : 嗯。玩得开心。我会拿着我的扫帚在这儿。
: 好！那……回见！
: 回见。
: {i}不过大概比你想象的更快……{/i}

lines.en: Uta Ushibori, bipedal human being, made it to the door roughly ten seconds later.
lines.zh: Uta Ushibori，双足行走的人类，大约十秒之后走到了那扇门前。

lines.en: But it was a very long ten seconds. And time itself would screech to a halt shortly after.
lines.zh: 可那是非常漫长的十秒。而时间本身，也在那之后不久发出刺耳的刹车声，停了下来。
: {i}嗯啊！嗯呜！嗯嗯！啊嗯……哼嗯……啊嗯……啊嗯嗯嗯！{/i}
: {i}啊！啊……嗯……呜……嗯！Akira……嗯！呜……嗯！嗯呜！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m...mmlhm...making you...keep the maid outfit on...next time...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我……嗯……要让你……下次穿着女仆装……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Mngh...mnh...you truly wish...to taint...mngh...the purity of Uta-chan?...When Uta wants you...mmmfh...this badly?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯……嗯……你真的想……玷污……嗯……Uta 酱的纯洁吗？……可 Uta 想要你……呜……想要得这么厉害？……{/i}
: {i}有……规定说不能……两个都要吗？……{/i}

lines.en: Needless to say, things were pretty fucked.
lines.zh: 不用说，事情已经烂透了。
: 这也太操蛋了……

lines.en: : Yeah. I probably should have warned you about this. But I figured you wouldn’t believe me and that you’d just need to see it for yourself anyway.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我大概早该警告你的。不过我觉得你不会信我，而且你反正也得亲眼看到才行。
: 你早就{i}知道{/i}？……

lines.en: : Yup. It’s been way closer to ten days than ten hours at this point, though.
lines.zh: : 对。不过到这会儿，比起十小时，倒是离十天更近了。
: 这是什么？……

lines.en: : I think they call it “snogging” in the UK.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在英国，他们管这叫“亲热”。

lines.en: : I obviously don’t mean what they’re-
lines.zh: : 我显然不是问他们——

lines.en: : Shhhhh! If {i}that{/i} Uta turns around to find {i}this{/i} Uta, it will shatter this dimension entirely and all traces of you will forever cease to be!
lines.zh: : 嘘！如果{i}那个{/i} Uta 转过身来发现{i}这个{/i} Uta，这个次元会整个碎掉，而你存在过的一切痕迹都将永远消失！
: ……大概吧。
: 大概？

lines.en: : Time’s a complicated thing, okay? I’m just here to mop cum off the floors and hand out condoms to girls who forgot to bring any.
lines.zh: 时间是件复杂的东西，好吗？我在这儿只是负责把地板上的精液拖干净，再给那些忘了带套的女孩发避孕套。
: 我现在是在做梦……对吧？

lines.en: : Not exactly. But everyone always seems to think that when they get tossed into precarious positions like this. Probably human nature or something like that. A coping mechanism maybe?
lines.zh: 不完全是。不过每个人被扔进这种危险的境地时，好像都会这么想。大概是人类的本性之类的吧。也许是一种应对机制？

lines.en: : {i}Aaaaah! Master! Please be...gentle down there! Mngh!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊啊！主人！请……轻点！嗯！{/i}

lines.en: : Wha...{i}this{/i} one got even further than I did!
lines.zh: : 什……{i}这个{/i}我比我那次进展还远！

lines.en: : You should have seen the one in 501. She actually brought the maid costume with her and got fucked so hard it put a hole in the wall.
lines.zh: : 你该看看 501 房那个。她真的把女仆装带来了，被操得狠到在墙上撞出一个洞。

lines.en: : How...many {i}are{/i} there? And {i}why?{/i} One second, I’m looking at my phone and the next...{i}this{/i} is happening. I don’t even know what this {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有{/i}……多少个？还有{i}为什么{/i}？上一秒我还在看手机，下一秒……{i}这种事{/i}就发生了。我连这到底{i}是{/i}什么都不知道。

lines.en: : Hmmm...I think they call it a “bad ending” or something like that?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得他们管这叫“坏结局”之类的？
: 坏……结局？

lines.en: : Basically, you took too long to go through with having sex and now your route is cancelled to make more time for the others.
lines.zh: 基本上，你迟迟不肯把爱爱做实，所以现在你的路线被砍掉了，好给其他人腾出更多时间。

lines.en: : Which has landed you in what I can only assume is your own personal rendition of Hell where there are a million other versions of you all getting what you want while you’re forced to watch.
lines.zh: 这也把你丢进了我只能假定为你个人版本的地方——地狱里有上百万个其他版本的你，全都得到了她们想要的，而你被迫在一旁看着。

lines.en: : Think of this building like a giant cuck chair and you’ll get the gist of it, I think.
lines.zh: : 你把这栋楼想象成一把巨大的绿帽椅，我想你就懂了。

lines.en: : Who are {i}you{/i} then?...And why do you know so much?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}是谁？……还有你为什么知道这么多？

lines.en: : Good question. I think I’m just a janitor. I’m still kind of new to this job. But hey, you’ll be around for the rest of forever, which will gives us plenty of time to find that answer ourselves.
lines.zh: 好问题。我想我只是个清洁工。我干这行还挺新的。不过嘿，你会在这儿待到永远的尽头，那我们有的是时间自己去找答案。

lines.en: : We’re going to be such good friends!
lines.zh: : 我们会成为非常好的朋友！
: 我不……

lines.en: : I don’t even know how to {i}begin{/i} processing this...
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道该从何{i}开始{/i}消化这件事……

lines.en: : It’s like...like a nightmare but...it feels so real...
lines.zh: : 这就像……像一场噩梦，可……它感觉好真实……
: 因为它本来就{i}是{/i}真的，傻瓜！

lines.en: : And if you weren’t so busy thinking about dick and all the ways to not receive it, you would have picked up on what your precious {i}Master{/i} said at the maid cafe about timeloops!
lines.zh: 而且如果你不是满脑子都想着鸡巴、以及所有不用去挨它的办法，你早该注意到你宝贝的{i}主人{/i}在女仆咖啡厅说的那些关于时间循环的话了！

lines.en: : To be frank, though, whoever Frank is, it’s kind of weird that you haven’t picked up on any of this sooner given how many times you’ve experienced these...well, let’s just call them {i}hiccups.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过坦白讲——不管这个 Frank 是谁——你经历了那么多次这种……好吧，我们就叫它们{i}打嗝{/i}好了，你居然到现在还没察觉出任何端倪，还挺奇怪的。
: 我不明白……

lines.en: : The infinite dorms. The hole beneath the city. Mysteriously receiving nudes of your younger self from private numbers despite basically changing your identity.
lines.zh: 无限的宿舍。城市地下的洞。明明基本换了身份，却还是从匿名号码那里收到年轻时的自己的裸照。

lines.en: : That...S...Stalkers can still find ways around that!
lines.zh: : 那……那……跟踪者总有办法绕过这些的！

lines.en: : There was also that picture you received of yourself from the future a few minutes ago until you decided to forget about it in pursuit of one more round of blue-balling.
lines.zh: 还有几分钟前你收到的那张来自未来的自己的照片——直到你决定把它忘掉，去追求又一轮的欲求不满。

lines.en: : Which really raises the question about how much of tonight was real {i}at all{/i} when we both know you’re not the type to ever be that assertive and open about your sexual needs.
lines.zh: 这真的引出了一件事：今晚{i}到底{/i}有多少是真的——毕竟我们都知道，你不是那种在性需求上会那么主动、那么坦白的人。

lines.en: : You...You don’t know me...This isn’t happening...You’re not even real! You’re some...dream person I clearly based off of Ami!
lines.zh: : 你……你不认识我……这不是真的……你甚至不是真的！你是某个……我明显照着 Ami 的样子造出来的梦中人！

lines.en: : Close, but no cigar. I’m actually the one who popped that precious little girl out of me before dying in a hideous car wreck. Surprise!
lines.zh: 差一点，但没猜中。其实，我就是那个把那个宝贝小女孩从我肚子里挤出来的人，然后在一场惨烈的车祸里死掉了。惊喜吧！

lines.en: : You’re...you’re Ami’s mom?! You’re a ghost?!
lines.zh: : 你……你是 Ami 的妈妈？！你是鬼？！

lines.en: : Are you surprised because I still look so young? Dying does {i}wonders{/i} for your skin, you know.
lines.zh: : 你惊讶是因为我看起来还这么年轻吗？死亡对皮肤有{i}奇效{/i}的，你知道的。

lines.en: : I...I don’t care who you are! Just...get me out here! Tell me what I need to do to leave!
lines.zh: : 我……我不管你是谁！只要……带我离开这儿！告诉我该怎么做才能走！

lines.en: : I don’t think you can, Uta. I think you’ll just wind up being replaced like all of the other girls who had their routes cancelled.
lines.zh: 我觉得你走不了，Uta。我觉得你最后只会像其他所有路线被砍掉的女孩一样，被替换掉。
: 还有……更多？

lines.en: : An infinite number of them, really. Which makes you a lot less special than you’ve been led to believe. So how about I go over it in a little more detail?
lines.zh: 真的有无数个。这让你远没有你被引导着相信的那么特别。那么我干脆讲得再详细一点？

lines.en: : I’ll take that silence as a, “Yes please, Arakawa-sensei! Please educate me so that I may spend the rest of this infinite spring in the know!”
lines.zh: 我就把这沉默当成一句“好的求你了，Arakawa 老师！请教导我吧，好让我在这无尽的春天余下的时光里做个明白人！”

lines.en: : We all exist inside of a big circle. There’s no beginning or end despite what the gods may tell you and everything you know and feel is part of an ever-repeating cycle.
lines.zh: 我们都存在于一个大圆里。它没有起点也没有终点，不管众神怎么跟你说；你所知道和感受的一切，都是一个不断重复的循环的一部分。

lines.en: : {size=-2}The reasons for this are unclear at the moment, but I like to believe it’s some sort of divine punishment — similar to what you’re experiencing for being one of the most egregious cock-teases I have ever seen.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}目前原因还不清楚，但我喜欢相信那是某种神圣的惩罚——就像你此刻正在经历的那样，因为你是我见过最恶劣的鸡巴诱饵之一。{/size}

lines.en: : Our jobs are not to act as individuals with free will or thought, but rather statuesque sacrifices fed to a pantheon of hungry celestial entities who are really just trying to do the same thing we are.
lines.zh: 我们的职责不是作为拥有自由意志或思想的个体去行动，而是充当雕像般的祭品，被喂给一群饥肠辘辘的天界存在——而那些存在其实只是在努力做着和我们一样的事。

lines.en: : Be. Exist. Elevate. Feel. Or, as I like to say-
lines.zh: : 存在。活着。升华。感受。或者，就像我喜欢说的——
: BEEF！

lines.en: : For we are nothing but meat when all is said and done — recycled carbon best suited for the mouths of higher powers that will stop at nothing to remind us how it feels between their teeth.
lines.zh: 因为说到底，我们不过是一堆肉——被回收的碳，最适合送进更高存在的嘴里，而它们会不惜一切地提醒我们，夹在它们牙缝之间是什么感觉。

lines.en: : So what can we do about it, you ask? Apart from fattening ourselves up and filling ourselves with all that They need to survive.
lines.zh: : 那我们能怎么办呢，你问？除了把自己养肥、填满它们生存所需的一切。

lines.en: : Nothing! For everything has already been done and nothing new can start because circles only have so much room and are tough to elongate when you don’t know how shapes work.
lines.zh: 什么也做不了！因为一切都已被做完，没有什么新的可以开始，因为圆圈只有那么大，而你在不懂形状怎么运作的时候，很难把它拉长。

lines.en: : Big bang? Old news. Fake news. You can not create what has always {i}been.{/i} Which probably means you can’t destroy it either.
lines.zh: 大爆炸？旧闻了。假新闻。你无法创造那一直{i}存在{/i}的东西。这大概也意味着你无法毁灭它。

lines.en: : So even if, by some stretch of imagination, you {i}do{/i} find a way out of here and retain all of your memories, they’ll amount to nothing more than fear and one more reason for divine intervention.
lines.zh: 所以即便你发挥想象力，{i}真的{/i}找到了离开这儿的办法并保留了全部记忆，它们也只会化作恐惧，以及再一个神圣干预的理由。

lines.en: : Behind the scenes, there are those who document it. Those just as powerful as the powers that be, but those who {i}use{/i} such powers to {i}chronicle{/i} instead of create.
lines.zh: 在幕后，有人把这些记录下来。那些存在和当权者一样强大，却{i}用{/i}这种力量去{i}编年{/i}，而不是去创造。

lines.en: : The xoanon, they are. Primitive images of God. Our first ideas and depictions of what we think is out there and, at the same time, the first time we were ever correct about anything.
lines.zh: 那就是木神像（xoanon）。神的原始形象。我们最初的想法、最初的描绘——关于我们认为外面有什么；同时也是我们有史以来第一次把某件事猜对。

lines.en: : Because we live in a place where everything you can imagine is real. Where worlds exist just by {i}thinking{/i} they do, but we can’t even {i}reach{/i} them because we made them for someone else.
lines.zh: 因为我们住在一个你所能想象的一切都是真实的地方。那里的世界仅仅因为{i}认为{/i}自己存在就存在，可我们甚至{i}够不着{/i}它们，因为我们是替别人造的。
: 然而，它依然在溃烂。

lines.en: : Still they grow and consume and eat what the gods do not because all stories need {i}characters!{/i} We’re pieces of an ever-growing puzzle that just expands any time you slot a piece into its correct position!
lines.zh: 它们依然在生长、吞食、吃掉众神不吃的东西，因为所有的故事都需要{i}角色{/i}！我们是一幅不断膨胀的拼图的碎片，每当你把一块放进正确的位置，它就又扩大一圈！

lines.en: : What’s the point, Uta?! There isn’t one! There’s no reason for any of this! So when you sit there all {i}confused{/i} and {i}sad{/i} that you haven’t sucked a cock yet, remember that cocks aren’t even real!
lines.zh: 意义何在，Uta？！没有意义！这一切都没有理由！所以当你坐在那里{i}困惑{/i}又{i}难过{/i}、为还没口交过而郁闷的时候，记住——鸡巴根本就不是真的！

lines.en: : {size=-4}Yet there are things and concepts out there shoving branches into bike tires — like the passage of time or the Great Plague of Monet. Interchangeable terminology that, like us, matters not at the end of the day for tomorrow shan’t ever come.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}然而外面还有各种事物和概念，正把树枝塞进自行车的轮辐里——比如时间的流逝，或者莫奈大瘟疫。这些可以互换的术语，和我们一样，到头来都无关紧要，因为明天永远不会到来。{/size}

lines.en: : So when your leaves begin to wither in the depths of this grave you’ve dug yourself and your mind begins to rot the way mine did after watching yous who aren’t {i}you,{/i} just know that it is meaningless.
lines.zh: 所以当你的叶子开始在你自己挖的这座坟墓深处枯萎，当你的心智开始像我的一样腐烂——在看完那些不是{i}你{/i}的你之后，你只要知道：这一切都毫无意义。

lines.en: : And that even if you had the balls to get out there and fondle some, you’d still end up in infinity the moment you went home. So ask yourself this-
lines.zh: 而且即便你有胆子走出去摸上几把，你回家的那一刻依然会掉进无限里。所以问问你自己——

lines.en: : {size=-2}Aren’t you happier here? Where you’re more than just a number? Where you’re more than a tool some writer uses to get across the same tired themes that, too, have been circling the drain since the pipes were hooked up?{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}你在这儿不是更开心吗？在这儿你不止是一个数字？在这儿你不止是某个作家用来表达同一套陈腐主题的工具——而那些主题，从管道接上的那天起，也一直在下水道口打转？{/size}

lines.en: : Or is it nobler to die as a work of art than it is to escape the fate of a statistic?
lines.zh: : 还是说，作为一件艺术品死去，比逃脱一个统计数字的命运更高贵？

lines.en: : This is all but one more paradox in a world that is full of them.
lines.zh: : 这不过是一个充满悖论的世界里的又一个悖论。

lines.en: : And {i}you{/i} are one more paradox as well.
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}也是一个悖论。

lines.en: : So the next time you round a corner and peer through the window into a world where you’re a little less pathetic, remember that it’s {i}better{/i} to be out in the hall than in one of those rooms.
lines.zh: 所以下一次你拐过街角、透过窗户窥见一个自己没那么窝囊的世界时，请记住：站在走廊上，比待在那些房间里{i}更好{/i}。

lines.en: : And that just because your route has been cancelled doesn’t mean you still can’t write a new story here.
lines.zh: 还有，你的路线被砍掉，不代表你就不能在这儿写一个新的故事。

lines.en: : The end. Thank you for coming to my TED Talk. And rejoice at the fact that no rope was involved this time.
lines.zh: : 完了。感谢各位来听我的 TED 演讲。另外请庆幸这次没用到绳子。

lines.en: : Still processing? Or do you get it now?
lines.zh: : 还在消化？还是说你现在懂了？
: 我懂了……

lines.en: : I get that this isn’t real...but I never thought it was in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我懂了这不是真的……可从一开始我就没觉得它是真的。

lines.en: : Then why were you so scared? Why are you still scared now?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么那么害怕？为什么现在还在害怕？

lines.en: : It’s because being scared is all you know.
lines.zh: : 因为害怕是你唯一会的事。

lines.en: : And it’s all you’ll {i}ever{/i} know if you don’t act soon.
lines.zh: : 而如果你不尽快行动，那也是你{i}永远{/i}唯一会的事。
: 就当你已经被“世界”过了。
: 现在，去让自己变得重要起来吧。
: 帮我入土为安。

lines.en: : Okay. Message sent. I will now go back to focusing entirely on Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 好了。消息发出去了。我现在要回去全身心专注在 Uta 酱身上了。
: 其实……

lines.en: : Can you tell me more about what you just said?
lines.zh: : 你能不能再多讲讲你刚才说的那些？
{i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
